assumptions.statement: OS, kernel, Rust dependencies and hardware implement documented APIs; memory safety outside reviewed code is trusted.
Vault root inode stays stable; cooperating Unix participants honor directory flock. Rename/hard-link/fsync semantics depend on filesystem; network mounts and power-loss behavior are not qualified.
SHA-256 collision resistance and implementation correctness are assumed, not proved here.

All released CLI native dispatch remains guarded unqualified. A provider binary/version/hash, observed session ID or first compaction item on a private connection does not establish exclusive custody or a provider-attested operation binding.

Explicitly admitted plugins, model bridges and scorers execute with user authority; bundle/hash admission and process-group cleanup are not an OS sandbox. Model weights behind stable endpoints may change.

Canonical provider/home/store/session identity and frozen source/candidate hashes must agree. Stable owner-controlled ancestors and executable paths are trusted; hostile same-user replacement, mounts and loader races remain excluded.
Clocks govern scheduling only; restart, clock movement, cooldown and effective configuration changes cannot release unresolved durable native work.

TLA+ models explore declared finite actor domains with atomic durable abstract actions and no fairness. Lean list laws are unbounded at the algebra layer; Rust correspondence is finite. Kani proves selected production scalar kernels over full domains and explicitly bounded sequences. No whole-program refinement follows.
Lossy content replacement has empirical task-dependent retention; literal/lexical scores are proxies and do not establish semantic equivalence.
A caller may request exact identity/content output; configured credentials and provider home choose real external authority. Background logs have narrower disclosure authority.
Historical receipts establish only their recorded tree, command, tools, environment and bounds; they are not reusable integration or activation gates.

coverage.name: Normalized context and token arithmetic
coverage.bounds: Selected production arithmetic and UsageSample kernels have explicit Kani harnesses; absent, reported zero, reset, partial and full lifetime states remain distinct.
exclusions: Parsing, provider meaning, allocations and all core behavior are not proved.

coverage.name: Plan IR and admission
coverage.bounds: One production scalar admission kernel controls plan/edit/target bounds and rejection atomicity; Kani covers scalar domains and declared bounded sequences.
exclusions: No whole-adapter theorem; callback and serialization behavior remains separately tested.

coverage.name: Strategy selection, protected tail, ranking
coverage.bounds: Shared admission, conservative suffix and explicit protected/unknown payload rules; production strategy regressions and fixed dialect corpus.
exclusions: Choice quality and retention are empirical; all future task semantics are outside the proof.

coverage.name: Provider discovery and active context
coverage.bounds: Strict duplicate-aware frozen byte parsing and synthetic supported dialect oracles; bounded regular-file prefix discovery.
exclusions: Schema/version drift and provider memory are unqualified; liveness is not custody.

coverage.name: Structural verification
coverage.bounds: Independent synthetic expected validity/projections and finite Lean-to-Rust correspondence cover three supported dialects.
exclusions: A clean structural report is not proprietary provider resume acceptance or semantic equivalence.

coverage.name: Copy/fork transaction and retry receipts
coverage.bounds: All participating copies retain source and exact candidate before no-clobber output. Version 2 receipts reconcile exact bytes without rerunning a strategy; visibility and durability are distinct.
exclusions: Owner-controlled stable ancestors and cooperating locks assumed; operation pins grow indefinitely; no physical power-loss theorem.

coverage.name: Vault, recovery, pruning
coverage.bounds: Strict bounded roots and history, shared readers/exclusive prune, retained intent pins and fail-closed unlink ordering. Finite custody/publication models plus injected storage failures and operation sequences.
exclusions: Finite abstract actions do not establish real filesystem durability or unbounded refinement; no abandoned-pin retirement.

coverage.name: Devin SQLite mutation/restore
coverage.bounds: Direct store writes and restore refuse before effects; canonical export and pure byte transformation remain available.
exclusions: No qualified direct mutation custody exists; disabled is not a proof of hypothetical store mutation.

coverage.name: Native compaction and watch state
coverage.bounds: Version 1 durable journal and generation 9 conservative watch cache, exact target locks, durable dispatch-before-call and permanent unknown suppression. Release native dispatch guarded.
exclusions: No live cells qualified; Codex first-item association and weaker ACP session correlation remain assumptions; fixture evidence only.

coverage.name: Hooks and settings
coverage.bounds: Exact settings ownership and inert private bundles; bounded strict callback input, exact frozen source identity and unpaired zero-savings observations.
exclusions: Provider-owned settings activation and exact callback operation correlation are unqualified.

coverage.name: Configuration and plugins
coverage.bounds: MCP refuses configured extensions before effects and skips inference. CLI trusted execution uses hash-declared bundles, bounded dual streams/deadlines and owned process groups.
exclusions: Trusted executable can perform arbitrary user-authority I/O; no sandbox or escaped-descendant theorem.

coverage.name: Model scorers/digests
coverage.bounds: Installed Apple bridge only; cache identity covers exact submitted bounded source/task projection, schema and available model/client identity. Strict complete results and bounded owned inference preserve heuristic fallback.
exclusions: Omitted full-source context, opaque model weights and future task correctness are not attested; ambient loaders/environment and stable owner-controlled parents remain trusted; no live Apple/keychain/provider qualification.

coverage.name: MCP and CLI inspection
coverage.bounds: 64 KiB strict JSON-RPC frames, supported protocol versions, closed diagnostics and explicit recovery-content opt-in; MCP planning has no external-execution opt-in.
exclusions: Explicitly authorized outputs may be sensitive; admitted external planning code is trusted.

coverage.name: Evaluation, retention, reporting
coverage.bounds: Source-hashed usage provenance, reported/missing/reset distinctions, deduplicated exact evidence pairs, incomplete coverage reporting and registered four-arm synthetic controls.
exclusions: Recorded occupancy reduction is not billed savings; lexical/judge retention is not future-task success.

coverage.name: Monitor and experiments
coverage.bounds: Private isolated outputs, bounded owned subprocesses, read-only monitor and shared-custody retention reader; provider study requires explicit opt-in.
exclusions: No real account/provider qualification from offline fixtures; no aggregate all-process resource theorem.

coverage.name: Build, supply chain, public claims
coverage.bounds: Pinned proof tools, expected-failure mutants, exact input hashes and required Linux proof/test jobs; complete immutable baseline scanner triage.
exclusions: Integration/installation evidence recorded separately; no alert-free security theorem or universal platform qualification.

compatibility.read_write_behavior: Additive optional/defaulted fields; enum vocabulary and validation are closed. Malformed/unsupported entries must not be interpreted as successful operations.
compatibility.upgrade_downgrade: No destructive migration. Older readers may ignore additive fields; new action/outcome vocabulary requires explicit compatibility tests.

compatibility.version: write schema_version=3; read 3, 2 or absent legacy record version; legacy raw objects
compatibility.read_write_behavior: Version 3 chunk reconstruction checks hashes/size/source hash; unsupported numbered manifest versions refuse. Index optional fields default for old records. Raw Devin SQLite objects remain archived but replay refuses them; replay requires a canonical single-session export and does not materialize a raw store.
compatibility.upgrade_downgrade: Manifest digest differs from reconstructed source digest. Older binaries may not read v3; preserve old artifact/state, never down-convert by overwriting originals.

compatibility.version: write schema_version=2; explicit legacy version 1 reader
compatibility.read_write_behavior: Strict closed fields and source/provider/identity/hash bindings. V2 retains before and exact candidate objects; pending legacy receipt without candidate refuses recovery. Prune validates every operation root.
compatibility.upgrade_downgrade: Never rewrite/drop unsupported receipts or pins. A completed legacy receipt is checked against its exact output; ambiguous/missing output remains blocked. No automatic pin retirement.

compatibility.read_write_behavior: Bounded strict exact-version state; conservative migration of older uncertainty. Missing registered journal, torn content or future version refuses; time expiry never clears native unknown.
compatibility.upgrade_downgrade: Older binaries ignore the durable journal and cannot safely resume watchers against unresolved new state. Preserve binary/config/state; rollback requires isolated read-only operation or reviewed reconciliation.

compatibility.read_write_behavior: Strict manifest/request/response fields, closed capabilities, executable plus declared bundle SHA. Commands execute with user authority under bounded host streams and deadlines.
compatibility.upgrade_downgrade: Version mismatch refused; no sandbox or forward schema negotiation. Requalify binary hash, capabilities and all effective inputs.

compatibility.read_write_behavior: Manifest source SHA and annotation schema bind the study source; typed labels do not establish label truth.
compatibility.upgrade_downgrade: Version/source mismatch refused; independent reviewed labels and held-out evaluation required for semantic claims.

compatibility.read_write_behavior: Additive provenance, measurement basis, qualificationStatus and nativeActivation fields. Full lifetime totals only; missing/reset context is not zero, replay reduction is not measured billing.
compatibility.upgrade_downgrade: Additive evolution under same profile only with compatibility tests; a new meaning/unit needs new version.

compatibility.version: detect / policy-check / plan --json / verify --json / vault --json: no global version
compatibility.read_write_behavior: Repository policy promises additive fields, not wire negotiation. policy-check --session reads provider state despite numeric form being pure.
compatibility.upgrade_downgrade: No blanket downgrade promise; semantic changes require explicit contract fixtures and versioned shape where necessary.

compatibility.read_write_behavior: Strict duplicate-free JSON-RPC 2.0, bounded 64 KiB newline frames and supported-version negotiation. MCP rejects configured extension strategies and skips model/scorer/digest execution; content opt-in changes only explicit recovery disclosure.
compatibility.upgrade_downgrade: Unsupported versions/shape refuse; no mutating or external-execution tool/flag advertised.

compatibility.read_write_behavior: Versioned repository evidence inventory; source markers and structural cross-checks, no proof inference.
compatibility.upgrade_downgrade: Unknown ledger versions reject; update validator and negative fixtures together on schema changes.
